title: GFCC Port Registry v1
description: Kernel dispatch depends on these interfaces only. Named services below the default line are optional adapters, unloadable via mode. gfcc is the contract layer; Tatha is one implementation of POST /v1/ask.

gfcc.default.notes: 五个端口仍可 stub。本模式不因 1.3.0 改变。

gfcc.terminal.notes: circle、consensus、contribution 不在本模式必选。memory.recall 最低角色仍是 observer；memory.remember 仍要 participant。

store_adapters.notes: cortex-mcp 是终端侧适配器。gfcc 是 pgvector 上的库名。两者只通过 actor_sub 关联。empty_on_boot 仍为真。

knowledge.demopeter.notes: RAG sample. Not a 格契 first-class port. Insight/observe is memory.observe, not this adapter.

memory.agentmemory_iii.notes: Third-party memory engine behind ctx.store. Unloadable.

job_match.notes: When value_axes is present, read survival as 钱多/salary_match, freedom as 事少/culture_workload_match, belonging as 离家近/location_match. The other six sub-scores and overall stay job-scoped. Model scores must not be written back onto the axes.

credit.notes: Must not be a consensus surface.
